pr.title: Retry invalid project locations and require matching local templates
pr.author: adamint

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Prepare Homebrew installer artifacts / Prepare Homebrew cask
failed_jobs.reason: Failed at 'Smoke test installed CLI (aspire new + restore)'. The PR makes substantial changes to src/Aspire.Cli/Commands/NewCommand.cs, src/Aspire.Cli/Packaging/PackageChannel.cs, and src/Aspire.Cli/Templating/TemplateNuGetConfigService.cs, which directly implement the 'aspire new' command and NuGet config/channel resolution exercised by this smoke test. No infra error patterns (network/registry/runner) were found in annotations; the only annotations are unrelated Homebrew tap-trust warnings, so the failure most likely stems from the PR's CLI behavior changes.
failed_steps: Smoke test installed CLI (aspire new + restore)

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, edge-cases)
failed_jobs.reason: Generic 'Process completed with exit code 1' with no retrievable job logs or TRX failures. This matches the prior recurring cause 'vscode-e2e-windows-edge-cases-flaky' (2 prior occurrences), a known intermittent shard failure unrelated to specific PR changes.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, workspace-target-proof)
failed_jobs.reason: The PR directly modifies extension/src/test-e2e/workspaceTargetProof.e2e.test.ts (+49/-3) and extension/src/test-e2e/helpers/vscode.ts (+12/-5), which is exactly the test suite exercised by this shard ('workspace-target-proof'). No job logs were retrievable, but the direct correspondence between the failing shard name and the PR-modified test file strongly indicates this is a code issue introduced by the PR rather than an unrelated flaky failure.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Prepare WinGet installer artifacts / Prepare WinGet manifests
failed_jobs.reason: Failed at the same 'Smoke test installed CLI (aspire new + restore)' step as the Homebrew job. Given the PR's large changes to NewCommand.cs, ProjectUpdater.cs, PackageChannel.cs, and TemplateNuGetConfigService.cs (the exact code paths exercised by 'aspire new' and package restore/channel resolution), this failure is attributed to the PR's CLI changes rather than infrastructure.
failed_steps: Smoke test installed CLI (aspire new + restore)
